notes: Follow-up fix after further real-world testing on the wrong-country problem: companies with 'Pvt. Ltd.' / 'Private Limited' in their own name (an Indian company-registration suffix) are now caught by name alone, even when the crawled page gave no other location clue. Also fixed: a company's site saying it serves 'North America' wasn't being read as a non-Europe signal at all, so a real US company slipped through a Europe-only report. These were verified against real companies confirmed via web search to be genuinely non-European. Reminder: if a run still looks thin or off for a market, first check that your DEEPSEEK_API_KEY in .env is a valid, working key.
